title: AI Multi-Agent Orchestrator
codeSnippet:
class AgentOrchestrator:
    def __init__(self, rag_engine, tools):
        self.rag = rag_engine
        self.tools = tools
        self.agents = [ResearchAgent(), CodeAgent(), QAAgent()]
    
    async def execute_task(self, prompt: str) -> ExecutionResult:
        # 1. Retrieve domain context via Vector RAG
        context = await self.rag.retrieve_top_k(prompt, k=5)
        # 2. Plan and delegate to specialized subagents
        plan = await self.agents[0].create_plan(prompt, context)
        return await self.dispatch_parallel(plan)
desc: Autonomous multi-agent orchestration framework featuring Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent subagent delegation, dynamic tool execution, and automated QA pipelines.

title: Global-NewsStream-Enterprise-Lakehouse-Real-Time-Media-Intelligence-Platform
codeSnippet:
from airflow import DAG
from airflow.operators.bash import BashOperator
from datetime import datetime

with DAG(
    dag_id='newsstream_etl_pipeline',
    start_date=datetime(2023, 1, 1),
    schedule_interval='@daily',
    catchup=False,
    tags=['news', 'etl'],
) as dag:
    scrape_task = BashOperator(task_id='scrape_news', bash_command='python /app/scrapers/run.py')
    process_task = BashOperator(task_id='process_lake', bash_command='spark-submit /app/pipelines/transform.py')
    load_task = BashOperator(task_id='load_warehouse', bash_command='python /app/warehouse/load.py')

    scrape_task >> process_task >> load_task
desc: This project builds a comprehensive, distributed platform for real-time media intelligence, leveraging a data lakehouse architecture to ingest, process, and visualize news article data. It integrates scraping, ETL/ELT pipelines, and advanced analytics for enterprise-grade media monitoring and insights.
features: Real-time data ingestion and stream processing with Apache Kafka for immediate insights.
Orchestrated data pipelines (ETL/ELT) using Apache Airflow for robust data transformation.
Scalable Data Lakehouse architecture combining MinIO and PostgreSQL for diverse data storage.
Interactive media intelligence dashboards and monitoring with Apache Superset and Grafana.
